errors.historyHint: It was recorded in the history.

env.name: Environment name

env.inKeyringTitle: In the system keyring: the environment file does not store the value
env.moved: "{name}" is now in the system keyring.
env.movedMany: {count} secrets moved to the system keyring.

history.openHint: Click to open it in a tab
history.clearBody: Every history entry will be deleted. Collections and environments are not touched.
history.masked: History stores secrets as ***. Put back the value or its {{variable}} before sending.

docs.hint: Basic markdown: headings, bold, italic, code, lists, quotes and links.

settings.title: Settings
settings.tlsWarning: With verification off, anyone on the network can impersonate the server.
settings.openBrowser: In browser mode, open it from your file explorer.
settings.maskInfo: Always on: the agent never sees secrets.

common.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard: {text}

policy.title: Agent · {name}
policy.intro: Rules for the calls an agent makes to this collection over MCP. From the app you can send any request.
policy.allowedHint: All checked means no restriction. Anything unchecked is rejected with error: policy.
policy.approvalHint: With the app open and the agent connected over HTTP you get a prompt to Approve or Deny; the agent waits up to 60 s.
policy.limitHint: Empty = no limit. Above it, the agent gets error: policy with how many seconds to wait.
policy.stdioNote: Over stdio (app closed) anything that needs approval is rejected: the agent gets error: policy and asks you.

about.tagline: Local HTTP client with an MCP server for agents. One binary, no account, no telemetry.
